lints.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

lints.name: unindexed_foreign_keys
lints.title: Unindexed foreign keys
lints.description: Identifies foreign key constraints without a covering index, which can impact database performance.

findings.detail: Table \`public.job_applications\` has a foreign key \`job_applications_search_profile_id_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.

lints.name: auth_db_connections_absolute
lints.title: Auth DB Connection Strategy is not Percentage
lints.description: Using a percentage based allocation connection strategy for Auth can help to improve the server's performance when increasing instance size.

findings.detail: Your project's Auth server is configured to use at most 10 connections. Increasing the instance size without manually adjusting this number will not improve the performance of the Auth server. Switch to a percentage based connection allocation strategy instead.
